cultural_references: The video uses the popular TikTok trend and audio meme 'funny haha, funny weird' to point out perceived hypocrisy.
central_claim: Marjorie Taylor Greene and House Republicans are hypocritical for claiming to care about the baby formula shortage while voting against funding to address it.
intended_effect: To make the viewer see Marjorie Taylor Greene and House Republicans as hypocritical and untrustworthy.
